title: Review Criterion Classes
description: Schema for review-criterion-classes.json (#3907): each diff-review criterion classified correctness (a warn is fixed before merge) or process (a warn is admitted). A criterion the file does not list is treated as the `unclassified` class, which is always correctness.

unclassified.description: How a criterion this file does not list is treated: fix-first, never silently admitted.

codeReviewCategories.description: The /code-review Step 5 categories (lowercased, spaces as hyphens) a finding on this criterion is filed under, so /code-review Step 8 can recognize a bug the gate filed.
